resources.string: Choose your workout preferences and your own nutrition targets. These settings do not change past logs or award points.
Preferred workout days. Leave all unchecked for no fixed schedule. Other days can receive recovery suggestions; the weekly target is a session count.
Available equipment. Choose “No equipment” or the items you have. Recommendations still depend on the available workout catalogue.

Enter targets you have chosen or agreed with a qualified professional. The app does not calculate a personalised diet prescription here. Leave a goal blank to keep it unset or clear it. Calories and macro targets are independent and are not automatically balanced.
Optional preferences saved for future food recommendations. They do not filter search yet or certify foods as halal, vegetarian or allergen-safe.
Preferences saved. Reopen the Exercise page to refresh recommendations. Nutrition preferences are saved for future recommendations.
Preferences could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry. Saving is disabled until your existing settings are loaded.
Preferences were not confirmed saved. Check your connection and sign-in, then retry.
Your profile could not be found. Return to Profile and complete setup first.
Your existing calorie goal may be an earlier default. Review or clear it before saving your choices.

Check your entries: duration 1–180 whole minutes, weekly target 1–7, and select equipment or “No equipment”. Optional calories must be greater than 0 and at most 20,000; macro goals must be 0–5,000 g. These are input limits, not recommended intake ranges.
